entities.name: Vronos
entities.description: A cathar and elite inquisitor of Avacyn who became a planeswalker after a werewolf attack, studied with the Ethersworn, and is tasked to capture Garruk.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker cursed with a blight of death magic, a huge corrupted brute who summons bears, defeats Vronos and hunts him.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel of Vronos's faith, freed from the Helvault, who forgives Vronos and sends him to bring Garruk to her cathedral.

entities.name: Sister Alina
entities.description: An attendant in the crèche who hummed songs from her Stensian home.

entities.name: Order of the Silver Heron
entities.description: The order of attendants at the cathedral crèche who raised children of the cleansed.

entities.name: Cathars
entities.description: The masked hunters of Avacyn's faithful who cleanse monsters and the cursed.

entities.name: Ethersworn
entities.description: Vedalken scholars who study etherium and planeswalking and who observe Vronos.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Blue-skinned scholars who replace flesh with etherium, one of whom judges Vronos.

entities.name: Twenty-Three Texts
entities.description: The holy texts of the Ethersworn, studied for the key to planeswalking.

entities.name: Etherium
entities.description: A mysterious metal tying beings to the sea of energy between planes, used by Vronos for his mask and implants.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison in which Avacyn and many demons were held until it opened.

entities.name: The Knight
entities.description: A previous planeswalker the Ethersworn observed.

entities.name: Avacyn's Cathedral
entities.description: The great cathedral where Avacyn receives Vronos and cathars gather.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: The home region of Sister Alina.

events.summary: Vronos shoots a woman in a village and orders the villagers' corpses burned, saving the children.
events.quote: Vronos issued his orders: some to heap the corpses in the village square

events.summary: Flashback: Vronos remembers his sister burned to purify her soul, after which the Order of the Silver Heron raised him in the cathedral crèche.
events.quote: They had taken him to the crèche within the cathedral where the children of the cleansed were raised by the Order of the Silver Heron.

events.summary: That night wolf-like child werewolves ambush Vronos's camp and kill his troops; he realizes the village children were not innocent.
Vronos is swarmed by the werewolves and the world goes dark; he next stands in an unknown place.
Vronos finds himself among the Ethersworn vedalken, who first judge him imperfect and then value him as a new planeswalker.
events.quote: This one might be of value.

events.summary: Vronos studies etherium and the Twenty-Three Texts with the Ethersworn, repairs his face with an etherium infix and mask, and learns to planeswalk and track other planeswalkers.
events.quote: he honed his planeswalking skill and discovered how to track others like himself by the faint trails they left in the Æther.

events.summary: Vronos returns as a penitent and Avacyn forgives him, accepting his renewed pledge.
events.quote: She kissed her maimed servant's brow and spoke words of forgiveness and understanding.

events.summary: Vronos becomes the Gray Fencer, first of the masked cathars, and accepts that the hunter cannot pity.
events.quote: Combatting evil meant hardening the heart. The hunter cannot pity.

events.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
events.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

events.summary: Vronos confronts the corrupted Garruk and is overwhelmed by his beasts, then wounded in the shoulder by his thrown axe.
events.quote: Garruk had simply hurled his weapon.

events.summary: Vronos flees by planeswalking to a cave and treats his wound with a poultice.
events.quote: He fled into the void, his enemy howling curses behind him.

events.summary: Vronos kills a doe for sustenance; Garruk finds him and swings his axe as Vronos bows his head.
events.quote: The axe whistled down. Vronos bowed his head.

relations.note: Vronos is her devoted cathar servant.
relations.quote: He pledged himself anew to her service.

relations.note: Vronos trained as a cathar and leads the masked hunters.
relations.quote: The filigreed visage of Vronos was always first among the dread hunters.

relations.note: Vronos hunts Garruk and loses to him.

relations.quote: these strange scholars, who named themselves the Ethersworn

relations.note: Avacyn wants him brought to her cathedral before his curse makes him a demon.
relations.quote: this affliction will transform him into a demon beyond any other
